description: Alert schema for agent monitoring: 8 alert definitions with conditions, severity, and actions.

alerts.name: retry_budget_exhausted
alerts.action: Stop agent; notify user; review retry policy

alerts.name: api_rate_limit_hit
alerts.action: Back off; check API endpoints; throttle calls

alerts.name: repeated_429
alerts.action: Investigate rate limiting; apply exponential backoff

alerts.name: memory_retrieval_failure
alerts.action: Verify memory files; reindex memory index

alerts.name: memory_write_failure
alerts.action: Check disk space; verify memory directory permissions

alerts.name: cross_session_recall_failure
alerts.action: Verify cross-session memory integrity; check session linking

alerts.name: task_failure_spike
alerts.action: Review failing tasks; fix root causes

escalation_path: HIGH severity: user notification required immediately
MEDIUM: report on next status check
LOW: log only, no action needed

example.name: retry_budget_exhausted
example.action: Stop agent; notify user; review retry policy
